first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both currently declining, and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding improves time-to-value while in-product activation messaging improves first meaningful action. A guarded onboarding simplification test is the most direct way to address both funnel weaknesses without sacrificing sustainable revenue through broad discounting. Monitor qualified activation, first meaningful action, retention, and downstream pipeline quality—not completion alone—to detect low-quality or merely superficial activation.

final.rationale: Run a standard, instrumented onboarding simplification experiment this week. The confirmed prior result directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and also improved time-to-value and 30-day retention, making it the strongest sustainable qualified-revenue lever. Track activation, first meaningful action, qualified conversion, and 30-day retention alongside completion to ensure the lift is not superficial. Use the activation-messaging result as a benchmark and possible follow-up, but do not split this week's single slot.
